items.paraphrase: On upper floors no point may be farther than 30 m from a protected exit stair, halved in basements.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; national Decree 351/79 Annex VII item 3.2.3.2 allows 40 m (read in a university copy)

items.paraphrase: The same 30 m limit to a protected exit stair applies to office floors; no separate office value exists.
Permanent-use rooms need daylight opening area of floor area divided by 15 for a side opening free of cover (divided by 12 under a covered part).
items.note: read 2026-11-14; 1/12 = 0.0833 if the opening is under a covered area; 20 percent reduction allowed on north-facing walls

items.clause: Annex I, Art. 21 item A.1.4.1 horizontal circulation
items.paraphrase: Horizontal corridors need a minimum side of 1.20 m with 1.50 m widenings every 20 m; exterior routes 1.50 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the official city gazette copy

items.paraphrase: Minimum clear passage of a door is 0.80 m, except rooms narrower than 0.80 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; Decree 467/98 0.90 m door concerns public transport vehicles, not buildings

items.paraphrase: A 1.50 m diameter circle must fit at corridor ends and every 20 m, at ramp landings and in lift cabins.
Ramp slope is tied to height overcome: 1:12 (8.33 percent) up to 0.30 m rise indoors or 0.20 m outdoors; gentler slopes (1:20 to 1:25) for rises up to 1.40 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; steeper 1:8 and 1:10 only for tiny rises (0.075 and 0.20 m); flights limited to 6 m horizontal projection

items.paraphrase: Fire sectors under condition C3 must not exceed 1000 m2 of floor; 2000 m2 if fully sprinklered.
items.note: searched 2026-11-14: official argentina.gob.ar Annex VII page returned 404; clause text read only on a university copy (www1.ing.unlp.edu.ar); mapping of office/residential uses to condition C3 not found in the text (tables not extractable)

items.paraphrase: Instead of fire walls, sprinklers allow condition-C3 sectors up to 2000 m2.
items.note: searched 2026-11-14: same as unsprinklered entry; clause read on university copy only, use-to-C3 mapping unconfirmed

items.paraphrase: Main stair riser between 0.15 and 0.18 m (0.16 m max for accessible stairs in mass-use buildings); 2R+G must be 0.60-0.63 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; accessibility decree 914/97 narrows to 0.14-0.16 m

items.paraphrase: Main stair tread (going) between 0.26 and 0.30 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; decree 914/97 requires 0.28-0.30 m for accessible stairs

items.paraphrase: General minimum clear width of a main stair is 1.20 m (1.10 m on narrow lots up to 8.66 m wide).
No separate house value found; the main-stair riser range of 0.15-0.18 m applies.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; single-dwelling-specific rule only for width

items.paraphrase: No separate house value found; the main-stair going range of 0.26-0.30 m applies.
A stair serving a single dwelling, or a multi-dwelling plot with four or fewer units, needs only 1.00 m clear width.
First-class (permanent habitation or work) rooms need clear height of 2.60 m regardless of area; service rooms 2.10-2.30 m.

items.clause: 3.3.1.2.1 table, class 1; class 3 for commercial work rooms
items.paraphrase: Permanent work rooms are first class at 2.60 m; third-class rooms for commerce and trade need 2.40 m up to 16 m2, 2.60 to 50 m2, 2.80 above.
items.note: read 2026-11-14; office classified as first class (permanent work) by interpretation
